'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**The [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] bombs the [[International University of Africa]] in [[Khartoum]], [[Sudan]], killing ten [[Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese]] nationals. [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Democratic Republic of the Congo)|DRC Foreign Minister]] [[Christophe Lutundula]] says his country has demanded an explanation from the [[Government of Sudan|Sudanese government]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-65821597 (BBC News)]
*Seventy-seven [[primary school]] girls are hospitalised after a poison attack on two schools in [[Sancharak District|Sancharak]], [[Sar-e Pol Province|Sar-e Pol]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/afghanistan-schoolgirls-poisoned-primary-taliban-3538031 (CNA)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2023 global energy crisis]]
**[[Ministry of Energy (Saudi Arabia)|Saudi Arabia's energy ministry]] announces a cut in [[Energy in Saudi Arabia|oil production]] from around ten million barrels per day this month to nine million barrels per day from July. [[Oil prices]] on [[Brent Crude|Brent]] and [[West Texas Intermediate]] [[Futures exchange|futures]] initially rise by more than two per cent, but later fall slightly. [https://www.cnbc.com/2023/06/05/opec-oil-prices-pop-after-saudi-arabia-pledges-production-cuts.html (CNBC)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Virginia plane crash]]
**A [[Cessna Citation V|Cessna Citation]] plane crashes over mountainous terrain after being intercepted by an [[General Dynamics F-16 Fighting Falcon|F-16 jet]] over [[Washington, D.C.]], killing the four people on board. The plane was flying from [[Elizabethton Municipal Airport]], [[Tennessee]], United States, to [[Long Island MacArthur Airport]], [[New York (state)|New York]]. [https://apnews.com/article/washington-virginia-maryland-loud-boom-crash-military-jet-biden-joint-base-andrews-d618f42933fbc595cc5836dede94524c (AP)]
*Fourteen people are killed and five others are missing after a [[landslide]] in a mountainous area near [[Leshan]], [[Sichuan]], [[China]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/landslide-chinas-sichuan-province-kills-14-leaves-5-missing-2023-06-04/ (Reuters)]
*One person is killed and 14 others are injured when a bus travelling from [[Lecce]] in [[Puglia]] to [[Rome]] crashes on a motorway in [[Vallesaccarda]], [[Campania]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.ansa.it/puglia/notizie/2023/06/04/bus-in-scarpata-in-irpinia-partito-da-lecce-era-diretto-a-roma_f9c075db-1b2e-4cf9-b4f5-cf9a0ad49342.html (Ansa)]
*One person is killed and ten others are injured in a fire at a [[refugee]] centre in [[Apolda]], [[Thuringia]], [[Germany]]. [https://apnews.com/article/refugee-center-fire-eastern-germany-60d336e18ee7781407ea87bb71e64aca (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Guinea-Bissau legislative election]]
**The citizens of [[Guinea-Bissau]] go to the polls to elect 102 members of the [[National People's Assembly (Guinea-Bissau)|National People's Assembly]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/guinea-bissau-holds-legislative-elections-amid-political-deadlock-2023-06-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[2023 Polish protests]]
**Anti-government protests erupt across [[Poland]], with an estimated 500,000 demonstrators gathering in the capital of [[Warsaw]], according to [[List of city mayors of Warsaw|Mayor]] [[Rafał Trzaskowski]]. [https://apnews.com/article/poland-democracy-march-tusk-kaczynski-duda-4ab13141a16b88d63b060c1f977bb75e (AP)]
